banner: Try the proposed lesson flow. Commands are real FFmpeg syntax, but Preview run does not execute them.
title: Make a six-second demo
subtitle: Choose a video, inspect its contents, then write a command to keep the useful part.

source.heading: Start with a recording
source.intro: Use the practice video or choose a recording from your device. File setup uses the app controls below.
source.sampleNote: A provided ten-second recording of a build queue being sorted, with a quiet synthetic tone.
source.importNote: Choose a video from this device. Its contents stay in this browser tab.
source.recordUnavailable: Screen recording is not connected in this prototype.
source.loaded: Practice video loaded. Replay it, then continue to Inspect.
source.importedReady: Video selected. Replay it, then continue to Inspect.
source.privacy: Your choice is kept for this tab only. The prototype does not upload files or change your saved course work.
source.watch: Watch for the starting state, the Sort action and the readable result.
source.watchImported: Replay your recording. Check that a viewer can follow the action and read its result.
source.playbackError: This browser could not play the file. You can choose another video or use the practice video.

inspect.heading: Find out what is in the file
inspect.intro: ffprobe reads media information without changing the file. A stream is a sequence of related media data, such as pictures or sound.
inspect.task: Request the file's streams and container information as JSON. In the practice video, look for one video stream and one audio stream.
inspect.predict: Before you preview the result, which stream should contain the synthetic tone?
inspect.resultNote: This report was recorded from the practice video beforehand. Preview run has not inspected your selected file.
inspect.importResult: No measurements are available for your imported file in this prototype. The command is ready to copy into a terminal with ffprobe installed.
inspect.streamSummary: The practice file has H.264 video and AAC audio. Its recorded container duration is ten seconds.
inspect.customResult: Your command is preserved below. This prototype does not execute or verify custom commands.

trim.heading: Keep the action and its result
trim.intro: For the practice video, start at two seconds and keep six seconds. This retains the Sort action and time to read the result.
trim.task: Choose a start time and duration. Read the command as it changes, then preview the proposed result.
trim.importTask: Choose times that suit your own recording. The prototype cannot check its duration or whether your chosen range exists.
trim.predict: Change the duration from six seconds to four. Which part of the viewing time are you removing?
trim.resultNote: This is a preview of the workflow. No command ran and no edited video was created.
trim.review: After a real run, replay the output: can a viewer follow the action and read its result?
trim.exportUnavailable: Video export is not connected in this prototype.
trim.tryAgain: Change the command and try again
trim.sourceSafe: The output uses a different filename so the source can be kept.

command.heading: Your command
command.builderNote: Choose values beside the FFmpeg options. The complete command remains visible and can be copied or edited.
command.manualNote: Edit the command directly. Switching views keeps your draft.
command.nativeBoundary: These are FFmpeg and ffprobe commands. To use them in a terminal, install the tools and put the source file in your working folder.
command.browserBoundary: The course runs media tools on browser workspace files. It does not provide an operating-system shell.
command.outputHint: Use a new .mp4 filename to keep the original.
command.copyFailed: Select the command text and copy it with your device's copy control.
command.downloadNote: The download contains the command text. Review it before running it on your computer.
command.empty: Enter an FFmpeg or ffprobe command first.
command.wrongTool: Use ffmpeg or ffprobe here. Loading files and replaying media use the app controls.
command.customWarning: You edited this command directly. Returning to the builder would replace it with the builder's current values.
command.typedRestored: Your typed command has been restored.
command.invalidTime: Use a start time of zero or more and a duration greater than zero.
command.invalidImport: Choose a nonempty video file no larger than 20 MiB.
command.rangeOutside: The practice video lasts ten seconds. Choose a start time and duration whose total is no more than ten seconds.
command.chooseReport: Select streams, container information or both before previewing the report.
command.invalidOutput: Choose a new filename ending in .mp4. Use letters, numbers, dots, hyphens or underscores.
command.sameOutput: Choose a different output filename to keep your source.

flags.heading: Read the options
flags.input: -i names an input file. The final filename names the output.
flags.probeStreams: -show_streams reports each picture or sound stream.
flags.probeFormat: -show_format reports the container, which organises the streams and their timing.
flags.probeJson: -of json requests structured text; -v error hides routine log messages.
flags.start: Here, -ss comes after -i. FFmpeg decodes the input and discards the part before the chosen start time.
flags.duration: -t limits the output duration. It is a length of time, not an end time in the source.
flags.mapVideo: -map 0:v:0 selects the first video stream from input 0.
flags.mapAudio: -map '0:a?' selects audio from input 0 when it exists. The question mark makes that selection optional.
flags.encode: -c:v libx264 encodes pictures as H.264. -c:a aac encodes sound as AAC.
flags.pixels: -pix_fmt yuv420p chooses a widely supported way to store picture colour.

actions.testPrompt: Load the practice video, preview its inspection, then change the trim duration. Try typing the command directly and returning to the builder.
actions.feedback: Notice where you hesitate, lose your place or cannot tell what will happen next. Those are the parts this prototype is testing.
actions.sourceChanged: Source changed. Review the command's filename before previewing it.
